articles.summary:
Australian industrial property developer Goodman Group has withdrawn an application to develop a 24-hour data centre on Sydney’s north shore following public push back.
Goodman said it would not proceed with its Project Mars development application after considering evolving federal and state policy and community feedback. articles.summary:

articles.title: China targets AI and frontier tech in newly unveiled innovation blueprint
